paragraphs: CrisisGo sells a safety platform to schools, businesses, public safety agencies, healthcare organizations and communities. Its flagship product, Safety iResponse, lets school staff communicate with one another and with first responders during an emergency.

The platform brings together alerts, planning, response, reunification, assessments, behavioral safety, visitor management and community coordination. Anonymous reporting is meant to let people raise concerns before situations escalate. Emergency notification runs across multiple channels.

The company says it has worked in the K-12 market for the past 10 years. It states that its leadership team has over 90 years of combined industry experience. One leadership bio says that Jim Spicuzza created SchoolCenter with two partners in 1999. CrisisGo names Amazon Web Services as a partner for a dependable connection, and lists an address at 800 W El Camino Real, Suite 180.

quote.text: CrisisGo unifies emergency response, preparedness, communication, and community coordination into one connected safety platform
